widgets_values: Generate and edit images with MiniMax H3 Image.

Omit input_images for text-to-image. For edits and composition, supply up to 16 ordered images and refer to them as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, etc.; identify the edit target explicitly. Describe the intended finished image in detailed English and preserve literal on-image text exactly. Prompts are passed through without rewriting. Width and height always set the output canvas, including edits; source dimensions are not automatically preserved. Use around 4–20 megapixels, preferably 16 MP. Recommended sampling: 6 steps, CFG 1, Euler/simple. Other settings are experimental for this distilled checkpoint. A negative prompt applies when CFG exceeds 1. No mask or denoise-strength control in this tool.
Diffusion steps; 6 is the distilled default.
Classifier-free guidance; 1 is the distilled default.
